detail.scene_description:
PRODUCT: Matte black multi-mode imaging scope matching the provided anchor shape and proportions, centered with a soft left cast shadow to ground it on the surface.
ATMOSPHERE: Remote pine forest at golden hour right before dusk, warm low-angle sunlight filtering through tree canopies, soft fading ambient daylight around the scene.
LAYOUT: 3:4 portrait canvas with 4% safe margins on all edges, scope occupies 45% of frame width in the middle 48% of height, bottom third is a continuous smooth rock surface with no seams, dividers or painted panels.
TYPOGRAPHY: No text or glyphs are painted on the base; all copy and icons will be added later via system overlay.
DECOR: No artificial decorative elements; only small natural pine needles scattered lightly on the rock surface for added realism.

struct_detail.company_summary:
Qingdao Lifiray Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd, is a professional manufacturer and R&D firm focusing on night vision devices and image intensifier tubes, located in Qingdao City.  
We focus on the full lifecycle of our core products - from R&D to manufacturing, ensuring consistent quality and performance.  
Our R&D team dedicates to optimizing the performance of image intensifier tubes-enhancing light-gathering efficiency and extending service life-while our manufacturing workshops adopt precision production processes to ensure consistent quality of night vision equipment.  
Our product portfolio caters to both professional users requiring high-end rugged devices and civilian clients in need of easy-to-use night vision tools.
One-Stop Solution: We provide end-to-end services including technical consultation, custom product design, small-batch trial production, large-scale manufacturing, and post-delivery technical support.  
We welcome global partners for cooperation, and are ready to join hands to explore broader markets in the field of night vision technology.
